picks.name: Horatio Luna
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Action Reaction" (May 2026) is his most fully realized record to date, six years after debut "Yes Doctor" -- a fluid, genre-blurring set moving between jazz, broken beat and electronic soul, built around exploring dualities: jazz and house, improvisation and composition.
picks.why_listen: Dancefloor-friendly spaced-out synths and thumping bass woven around in-studio exchanges -- a precise yet exploratory record from an artist already in your rotation.

picks.name: Various Artists (curated by Shannen SP)
picks.source_note: New label discovery: TraTraTrax. Similar South African bass/gqom territory to your Citizen Boy and DJ Jeff the Lastborn picks.
picks.bio: "Mzansi Bass" (June 12, 2026, TRA032) is Colombian label TraTraTrax's new sampler series, curated by Shannen SP -- eight tracks of South African electronic underground from veterans like DJ Lag to newcomers like Jay Music, spanning 3-step, gqom and the darker sides of amapiano.
picks.why_listen: A murky, trance-inducing, deeply physical snapshot of the current South African underground -- embodied, groove-forward material for a peak or transitional stretch of a set.

release.title: Mzansi Bass curated by Shannen SP
